author: dgusakov
content: Who can help me with CI being some nonsense here https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1962?

author: dhanush0512
content:
hey 
When `@eip-review-bot` approved and enabled auto-merge, it triggered the repo's `auto-review-trigger` workflow. That workflow has a bug where it runs `exit 1` on bot events to stop recursion, which accidentally marked the CI check as failed and blocked auto-merge.

Comment **`@eth-bot rerun`** on the PR (not `@eip-review-bot`, the workflow specifically listens for `@eth-bot`). That will rerun CI under your account and let it auto-merge. Alternatively, push an empty commit (`git commit --allow-empty -m "trigger ci" && git push`).

author: dhanush0512
content:
Looks like there are actually two things blocking `#1962` from auto-merging:

1. Sam still has an active **Changes requested** review from Oct 27, so GitHub won't auto-merge until that's cleared/dismissed.
2. The `Trigger` check also keeps failing because `@eip-review-bot`'s approval hits an `exit 1` in `auto-review-trigger.yml` (I opened a small fix for that in https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/2224).

So once Sam's review is re-approved or dismissed, an editor can just merge it directly. :D
